newsitem.title: USA: PIONEER HI-BRED SETS DUTCH AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: PIONEER HI-BRED SETS DUTCH AUCTION.

text.p: Pioneer Hi-Bred International Inc said Thursday it intends to commence a Dutch auction self tender offer after DuPont Co completes a planned $1.7 billion investment in Pioneer.

Earlier today, DuPont and Pioneer announced an agreement to form a research alliance and a separate joint venture company to speed development of new crops. As part of the agreement, DuPont will invest $1.7 billion in Pioneer, ultimately owning 20 percent of its stock.
Pioneer will use the proceeds from the investment to buy back its own shares.
The DuPont investment is scheduled to close after closing conditions are satisfied, including the expiration of the Hart-Scott waiting period.
